title: Release artifacts manifest
description: List of artifacts produced by a release build, with platform information, type and additional metadata.

name.description: Artifact file name, without leading or trailing whitespace.

path.description: Artifact location, using '/' as separator. Relative to the working directory when possible; container image references are kept as-is.

internal_type.description: Numeric type identifier. Not stable across versions; use 'type' instead.

ArtifactType.description: Human-readable artifact type. Several internal kinds may map to the same value (e.g. all binary variants are reported as 'Binary'). The list is open: unknown values must be accepted.

Extra.description: Additional metadata. Content varies by artifact type; unknown keys are allowed.

ID.description: Identifier of the configuration entry that produced the artifact.

Binary.description: Binary name (archives containing a single binary).

Ext.description: File extension, including the leading dot. May be an empty string when the artifact has no extension (e.g. a binary on Linux or macOS).

WrappedIn.description: Root directory name inside the archive.

Checksum.description: Checksum in 'algorithm:hex' format (crc32, md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512).

ChecksumOf.description: Identifies the artifact a checksum entry refers to.

Platforms.description: Platforms a container image was built for.

Replaces.description: Whether a universal binary replaces the single-architecture ones.

Files.description: Additional files included in an archive.

DynamicallyLinked.description: Whether the binary is dynamically linked.

Builds.description: Build entries associated with the artifact. Element type is unspecified.
